whenToUse: You check whether a mockup or finished screen is easy to use.
You check main flows before launch.
You see whether a fix really made things better.
whenNotToUse: You don't know what to build yet (use user interviews).
You choose whichever of two designs performs better on a metric (use an A/B test).
You only check the menu structure (use tree testing).

accessibility: Check separately whether keyboard and screen reader users can finish the same tasks.
Task wording doesn't reuse the words on screen, so it doesn't give the answer away.
